leakageControls: Rankings are the latest archived August redraft consensus snapshot for each season.
Each test season is projected only from seasons that occurred earlier.
Current coaching profiles, current injuries, and future-season outcomes are excluded.
Weekly lineup choices use only preseason projections and results from completed prior weeks.
Oracle and baseline strategies use paired season, slot, and random-seed scenarios.

policy.interpretation: Standardize the native score and multi-week roster utility, then use the leakage-safe training seasons to select their blend.

limitations: Synthetic one-for-one preseason offers test score direction, not manager acceptance.
Historical post-draft transactions and keeper costs are not reconstructed.

policy.interpretation: Unified-utility reranking won on training seasons but failed the untouched holdout; retain the need-aware champion.

limitations: Free-agent availability is approximated from players left undrafted in each historical mock.
The replay evaluates one add/drop decision after Week 4 and does not reconstruct real waiver priority.

trade.interpretation: Standardize the native score and multi-week roster utility, then use the leakage-safe training seasons to select their blend.

waiver.interpretation: Unified-utility reranking won on training seasons but failed the untouched holdout; retain the need-aware champion.

limitations: The committed benchmark covers skill positions and excludes kicker and team-defense slots.
Mock-draft opponents approximate market behavior rather than reproducing every historical room.
Historical value curves describe cohorts and do not guarantee an individual outcome.
Transactions after the draft are excluded from the draft-only benchmark.
